label: scam
title: HERO DEMO: 'grandson in jail' bail scam with gift cards and secrecy

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ethan? Is that you? You sound different.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, I, I have a cold, and I've been crying. Grandma, I'm in really big trouble.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I was in a car accident, and the police arrested me. I'm calling from the station right now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Arrested? Oh my goodness. Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm okay, but I need bail money or they're going to keep me here tonight. Please, I need it right now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: How much do you need? Should I call your mother?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No! Please don't tell Mom or Dad. They'll be so angry. Please, just keep this between us.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Well, okay. I don't want you to be in trouble.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My lawyer says the fastest way is gift cards. Can you go to the store and buy Google Play gift cards? Two thousand dollars.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Gift cards? For bail? That seems strange.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's how they do it here, Grandma. And don't hang up. Stay on the line with me while you drive to the store, okay?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I'm getting my keys.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: When you have them, scratch off the back and read me the numbers. Please hurry, before it's too late.
